NEWTON.name: Newton Strategy
NEWTON.description: Aligns a component by minimizing beam deviation on a specific camera axis.

COBYLA.name: Cobyla Alignment
COBYLA.description: Constrained Optimization by Linear Approximation. Good for multi-variable alignment. Real lab uses CobylaAlignmentStrategy_cloudlab: WiFi stepper comes from component_catalog `motor_controller`. In real mode, set a single-beam reference image from the Table cam panel (stored server-side) before running; it is passed as reference_image (same kind of BGR image as table-cam capture).

motor_ids.description: List of Motor IDs to adjust

objective_threshold.description: Stop when metric is below this

exposure.description: Camera exposure (s) for Cobyla video + capture steps

BAYESIAN.name: Bayesian Cavity Alignment
BAYESIAN.description: Uses Bayesian Optimization to find the global maximum for cavity power.
